question: Should the presentation-only lobster sidebar divider remain a temporary draft, be converted into an approved Control UI product change, or be closed after the demo?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow, but it changes a global desktop UI default and the PR body says it is not intended to land, so automation should not choose the product direction.

options.title: Keep as demo draft
options.body: Leave this PR open only while it is useful for the presentation demo and do not treat it as a normal landing candidate.

options.title: Convert to product change
options.body: Require explicit design/product approval, real desktop visual proof, and removal of the direct changelog edit before merge.

options.title: Close after demo
options.body: Close the branch once the presentation need is gone because the author stated it is not intended to land.

recommendation.title: Keep as demo draft
recommendation.body: Leave this PR open only while it is useful for the presentation demo and do not treat it as a normal landing candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the demo PR and has the clearest evidence-backed connection to the demo/product disposition.
